title: Lasagna Fields
intro: The ten whole-scan fields read straight from the public bucket by URL, logged out, with no download step; the scans they came from are open data. The page is also an API and an MCP server that makes a field for any box of any public scan.

sources.title: A whole-scan field: PHerc0175A cos, level 1 (every 2nd scan voxel)
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (derived from Vesuvius Challenge open data)
sources.note: Model output (villa lasagna at db3dbea2, scrollprize/lasagna at de45f011). grad_mag, nx and ny sit beside it, from level 2; PHerc0175A.lasagna.json in the same folder is villa's manifest. The other nine scans: replace the scan and run folder as listed on the Ten whole scans tab.

sources.title: X-ray CT that field came from, PHerc0175A 8.640 um
sources.note: Read live from the open-data bucket, never copied here. The field's level 1 is the scan's level 1 grid.

sources.title: Make a field for any box, from code or an agent
sources.license: Code Apache 2.0; villa lasagna and its checkpoint MIT; scans and fields CC BY-NC 4.0
sources.note: make_field (same arguments as plan_field) runs villa's lasagna on ZeroGPU and uses the caller's ZeroGPU time, so pass a Hugging Face token. Model output, not a reading.
